item.title: Episode 13: Behind the Mic — The Anatomy of Unfiltered
item.description: Alex pulls back the curtain on the show itself: four senior people, two cities, no hallway, no meeting-to-schedule-a-meeting. Then he and Morgan turn to the growth episode: twenty real downloads with zero inflation, and an unfiltered ask for support. No sponsor content in this one.
